read.en: Marvell rose 2.3% on Oct 23 to $228.51, trading between $221.38 and $231.62 on light volume (0.64 times average). It is below the falling 5-day ($234.9) and 10-day ($242.3) and the rising 30-day ($253.1) and 100-day ($241.3) averages, but above the rising 200-day ($179.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($255.74), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 迈威尔 10月23日上涨 2.3%，收于 $228.51，盘中区间 $221.38–231.62，成交清淡（为平均水平的 0.64 倍）。股价位于下行的 5 日（$234.9）和 10 日（$242.3）以及上行的 30 日（$253.1）和 100 日均线（$241.3）下方，但高于上行的 200 日均线（$179.6）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$255.74），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $226.5 Oct 16 and Oct 20 lows, support again; the $231.6 high stayed under the 5-day. Resistance is $231.6–234.9 (Oct 23 high, 5-day), then $241.3–242.3 (100 and 10-day) and $250 (Oct 21 high). Support is $226.5, then $220.2–221.4 (Oct 22–23 lows) and $200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close above $234.9 would target $241–242; a close below $220 would open $200.6.
